mapper.sql: SELECT l.*, r.name AS reader_name, r.reader_no AS reader_no, c.barcode AS barcode, c.book_id AS book_id, b.title AS book_title FROM loan l LEFT JOIN reader r ON l.reader_id = r.id LEFT JOIN book_copy c ON l.copy_id = c.id LEFT JOIN book b ON c.book_id = b.id

where.if: AND (r.name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR r.reader_no LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR c.barcode LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR b.title LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%'))

mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM loan l LEFT JOIN reader r ON l.reader_id = r.id LEFT JOIN book_copy c ON l.copy_id = c.id LEFT JOIN book b ON c.book_id = b.id
WHERE l.copy_id = #{copyId} AND l.status IN (0, 2) LIMIT 1
WHERE l.reader_id = #{readerId} AND l.status IN (0, 2) ORDER BY l.due_at
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM loan WHERE reader_id = #{readerId} AND status IN (0, 2)
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM loan WHERE reader_id = #{readerId} AND status = 2
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO loan (reader_id, copy_id, borrowed_at, due_at, returned_at, renew_count, overdue_days, fine, status, remark) VALUES (#{readerId}, #{copyId}, #{borrowedAt}, #{dueAt}, #{returnedAt}, #{renewCount}, #{overdueDays}, #{fine}, #{status}, #{remark})
mapper.update: UPDATE loan SET returned_at = #{returnedAt}, overdue_days = #{overdueDays}, fine = #{fine}, status = #{status}, remark = #{remark} WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.select: SELECT DATE_FORMAT(l.borrowed_at, '%Y-%m') AS month, COUNT(*) AS borrowCount, SUM(CASE WHEN l.status = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS returnCount FROM loan l WHERE l.borrowed_at >= DATE_SUB(DATE_FORMAT(NOW(), '%Y-%m-01'), INTERVAL #{months} MONTH) GROUP BY month ORDER BY month
